integrity: Two independently constructed graph representations and closure algorithms reproduce the optimum and all-pairs distance data; a third verifier checks the complete 144-map automorphism action and all 72 diametral pairs. All are standard-library Python scripts supplied with the result.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns exactly the 24-vertex Nauru graph, not other generalized Petersen graphs or infinite graph families.
The exhaustive certificate covers the precisely specified finite subsets, move relations, and all-pairs distances; it provides no statement about untested graph classes.
No independent external mathematical audit has been performed, and a differently indexed historical equivalent is possible.
title: A single diametral orbit in minimum sensor-slide reconfiguration of the Nauru graph
